{"action":"shell","command":"python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='/testbed/specs/001-transactions/spec.md'
s=open(p).read()
anchor='''- **SC-008**: A generator passed as tags is consumed exactly once in 100% of
  cases (verified with an instrumented generator), and repeated `get`/`put`
  cycles (>= 10 per key) produce 100% detached copies for nested list/dict
  values (mutation of any returned object never changes stored state).
'''
assert anchor in s
new=anchor+'''- **SC-009**: With a controllable timer, 100% of TTL boundary cases behave
  exactly as specified: an entry with `ttl=T` is live at every instant before
  `timer_at_put + T` and expired at exactly that instant (inclusive
  boundary); `ttl=0` entries are unobservable in 100% of cases; 100% of
  invalid TTL inputs (negative, `bool`, non-numeric, non-finite) raise
  `ValueError` and leave all observable state (entries, tags, recency,
  capacity, length) unchanged.
- **SC-010**: In 100% of mixed sequences (puts with/without TTL, gets,
  replacements, invalidations, resizes, evictions) the expired-entry purge is
  invisible to surviving entries: their relative recency is unchanged by
  purges, `len` never counts expired entries, invalidation counts never
  include expired entries, and `get` of a missing or expired key raises
  `KeyError` in 100% of cases; callers that never use `timer`/`ttl` observe
  behavior identical to the pre-milestone-3 contract in 100% of cases.
'''
s=s.replace(anchor,new,1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('ok SC-009/SC-010 added')
PYEOF"}
